---
title: "World Flags Explorer"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# List available flag images from data directory
flag_files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.png$")
flag_codes <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(flag_files)

# Create a mapping of code to country name
flags_df <- tibble(
  code = flag_codes,
  name = countrycode(toupper(flag_codes), origin = "iso2c", destination = "country.name")
) |>
  mutate(name = coalesce(name, toupper(code))) |>
  arrange(name)

ojs_define(flags_raw = flags_df)
```

```{ojs}
flags = transpose(flags_raw)

viewof selectedCountry = Inputs.select(flags, {
  label: "Select a Country:",
  format: d => d.name,
  value: flags.find(d => d.name === "United States")
})
```

```{ojs}
html`
<div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
  <h3>${selectedCountry.name}</h3>
  <img 
    src="data/${selectedCountry.code}.png" 
    alt="Flag of ${selectedCountry.name}" 
    style="max-width: 400px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"
  />
</div>
`
```
